To view a short video documenting the restoration of the Mathews Cabin, please click this link. In 1821, Josiah Allen Mathews (b. 1803) married Lucy Martin (b. 1805) in South Carolina. They came to Clarke County around 1830. Their children were: Joshua Lewis Mathews, David Mathews, Martin Mathews, Nancy Ann Celia Mathews Hicks, Elizabeth Mathews Harrison, Lucy Mathews Summers, Josiah (Joe) Mathews, Jr., Emaline Eleanor
